content_sections.heading: About GTU
content_sections.text: Gujarat Technological University was established by the Government of Gujarat under Gujarat Act No. 20 of 2007. The posts are in its School of Applied Sciences and Technology (GTU-SAST) at the GTU Chandkheda Campus, Ahmedabad, where the Major Research Project "Scalable Engineering and Environmental Technologies for Exposure Prevention" has been sanctioned by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Govt. of India. The Principal Investigator of the project is Prof. (Dr.) Vaibhav Bhatt.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 5 positions in total across three posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. The essential qualification and desired skills of each post are given below as printed. Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees in Materials Science/Environmental Science/Chemical Sciences etc. or relevant areas with 5 years of post-qualification experience. Ph.D. in Materials Science/Environmental Science/Chemical Sciences etc. or relevant discipline + 2 years of post-qualification experience. OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology/Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering, etc. or relevant engineering areas with 5 years' experience post qualification or PG degree with 3 years post qualification experience or PhD. Desired skills: Experience in research and development of engineering and technological solutions for occupational health and environmental exposure prevention. Candidates having working research experience in a Scientific and funding agency will be preferred. Knowledge of new materials developments, air quality monitoring, particulate matter analysis, silica dust monitoring, and industrial dust-control technologies. Experience in multidisciplinary research, project coordination, and collaboration with industry and research institutions. Essential qualification: Postgraduate (PG) degree including the integrated PG degrees in Biotechnology/Environmental Science/Materials Science/Nanotechnology/Instrumentation or relevant areas + 2 Years of experience. OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology/Materials Science/Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation, etc. or relevant engineering areas with 3 years' experience post qualification or PG degree with 1 years post qualification experience. Further skills listed in the notice: Hands-on experience in materials science, nanotechnology, chemistry, biotechnology, or a related discipline. Knowledge of 3D prototyping, tools developments, laboratory techniques, experimental protocols, sample preparation, and analytical methods. Experience in environmental monitoring, occupational exposure assessment, air quality analysis, or particulate matter characterization will be an added advantage. Essential qualification: Three Years Graduate degree in Biotechnology/Materials Science/Chemistry/Electronics or relevant subjects/field + 3 Years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject/field. OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology/Materials Science/Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation, etc. or relevant engineering subject. Desired skills: Hands-on experience in laboratory operations, sample preparation, and routine experimental procedures. Familiarity with environmental sampling, air quality monitoring, sensor-based instruments, or analytical techniques will be an added advantage. Ability to assist in prototype fabrication, assembly, experimental setup, data collection, and laboratory document

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All positions are purely on a contractual basis for 5 years, and the fellowship duration for each post is 5 years. The notice calls the pay a fellowship; each amount below is the basic amount plus 30% HRA.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for all three posts are made online through a Google Form. The notice gives these steps: Open the application form at https://forms.gle/Ge5yrksSwLUyWaT99 , or scan the QR code printed in the notice. Fill out the application form on or before 23 November 2026. The notice does not name any documents to be attached to the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on their qualifications and relevant experience. The date and details of the interview will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates via email. Candidates are required to attend the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA shall be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical), 3 Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and 1 Project Technical Support I (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GTU ICMR project posts?
faq.answer: The application form must be filled out on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Project Research Scientist I?
faq.answer: A PG degree (including integrated PG) in Biotechnology/Environmental Science/Materials Science/Nanotechnology/Instrumentation or relevant areas with 2 years of experience, or a BE/B.Tech in the listed engineering branches or relevant areas with 3 years' post-qualification experience, or a PG degree with 1 years post qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 45 years for Project Research Scientist III and preferably below 35 years for Project Research Scientist I and Project Technical Support I.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the GTU Project Research Scientist III?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist III gets Rs. 1,01,400 per month (Rs. 78,000 + 30% HRA) in the 1st and 2nd Year, Rs. 1,06,470 in the 3rd and 4th Year and Rs. 1,11,540 in the 5th Year.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. For every post, 30% HRA is added to the basic amount; for example, Project Technical Support I gets Rs. 28,000 + Rs. 8,400 (30% HRA) = Rs. 36,400 per month at the start.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill out the Google Form at https://forms.gle/Ge5yrksSwLUyWaT99 or scan the QR code in the notice, on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the GTU ICMR project posts?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted for an interview based on their qualifications and relevant experience, and the interview date and details will be sent to shortlisted candidates via email.

faq.question: Q9. Are the GTU project posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely on a contractual basis for 5 years under the ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA shall be provided.
